title: Updating a local variable
statement: For a list $l$ of integers, let its frame give the list entry at each index and $0$ beyond the list. Let $\mathrm{loc}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ agree with the frame of $l$ at every index outside a list $xs$. For any index $x$ and integer $z$, the function obtained by setting $\mathrm{loc}(x)=z$ agrees with the frame of the list obtained by setting its entry at $x$ to $z$, at every index outside $xs$.
hypotheses_covered: loc agrees with the frame of l at every y not in xs
